candidates.definition: The strange wistfulness and rich atmosphere of used bookstores, filled with thousands of old books you may never have time to read.
candidates.example: Walking into the quiet corner of the central library before semester exams gave everyone a sudden sense of vellichor.
candidates.etymology: Coined by John Koenig in The Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows, blending 'vellum' (parchment) and 'ichor' (ethereal fluid).
